# StageFlow

> StageFlow is a self-hostable frontend quality platform that runs accessibility, performance, SEO, security, link, spelling, and optional AI checks in rootless containers, then merges findings into one report.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://stageflow.org/): Product overview and scanner index.
- [Local projects](https://stageflow.org/projects): Browser-local projects and baseline comparisons.
- [Playground](https://stageflow.org/playground): Configure a one-off URL or static-site ZIP scan.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/mattboback/stageflow/blob/main/README.md): Setup and project overview.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/mattboback/stageflow/tree/main/docs): Architecture, operations, privacy, and configuration.
- [Source](https://github.com/mattboback/stageflow): MIT-licensed source code and issue tracker.

## API

- `GET /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/results`: Unified JSON report for a completed scan.
- `GET /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/report`: Standalone HTML report for a completed scan.

The hosted demo processes submitted targets and scan data on its deployment. Self-host StageFlow when data residency or private-target scanning matters.
